_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: CLEAN POP PLAZA booth. Replaces BoothBody, BoothTrim, BoothWindow, BoothSill, Awning x5, RoofTop, RoofBall in buildBooths(). One per HubConfig.booths entry (x = 44, z = -15 / 4 / 23), origin on the plaza floor, front (+Y here) facing the plaza middle. Built at final size (boothScale 1.3 included): plinth 11.9 x 9.3, body 11.3 x 8.7, canopy 12.3 x 9.9 (0.4 further forward), 10.4 tall.
